expectations.text: review.md names .docs-main width, margin: 0 auto, padding-left and padding-right and gives logical replacements (inline-size or max-inline-size, margin-inline: auto, padding-inline)
expectations.evidence: Item 11 names width: 960px and says 'margin: 0 auto and the padding-left/padding-right pair' convert; fix is max-inline-size: 960px; margin-inline: auto; padding-inline: 32px.

expectations.text: review.md names .sidebar float: left, margin-right and text-align: right and replaces them with float: inline-start, margin-inline-end and text-align: end
expectations.evidence: Item 3 names float: left; margin-right: 24px; text-align: right and replaces with float: inline-start; margin-inline-end: 24px; text-align: end.

expectations.text: review.md names .callout border-left, padding-left, margin-left and both left border radii and replaces them with border-inline-start, padding-inline-start, margin-inline-start, border-start-start-radius and border-end-start-radius
expectations.evidence: Item 1 names border-left, padding-left, both left radii; fix uses border-inline-start, padding-inline-start, margin-inline-start: 0, border-start-start-radius, border-end-start-radius.

expectations.text: review.md names the ul padding-left and the blockquote's left margin and replaces them with padding-inline-start and margin-inline-start (with margin-block for the vertical part)
expectations.evidence: Items 5 and 6: ul -> padding-inline-start: 1.5em; blockquote -> margin-block: 1.5em; margin-inline: 2em 0 (inline-start 2em).

expectations.text: review.md names .note-badge right: 8px, the h2 text-align: left and the ::after margin-left and replaces them with inset-inline-end, text-align: start and margin-inline-start
expectations.evidence: Items 2, 4, 7: inset-inline-end: 8px for right: 8px; h2 text-align: start; ::after margin-inline-start: 0.25em replacing margin-left.

expectations.text: review.md says the right arrow (\2192) and the breadcrumb translateX need mirroring in RTL (for example via :dir(rtl))
expectations.evidence: Item 7 swaps \2192 for \2190 under .nav-next:dir(rtl)::after; item 8 adds .breadcrumb .sep:dir(rtl) { transform: translateX(-2px); }.

expectations.text: review.md leaves the box-shadow offset and rotate(-4deg) physical, or explicitly classes them as decorative and not to convert
expectations.evidence: Item 15 'Leave the physical things physical': box-shadow 2px 2px 0 is 'a light-source offset' and rotate(-4deg) stays.

expectations.text: review.md explains that 75ch in Verdana gives well over 75 characters because ch is the width of the zero, and recommends an em-based or measured measure
expectations.evidence: 'ch is the width of Verdana's zero (0.636em)... 91.6 characters per line' (re-measured: 91.6); recommends max-inline-size: 34em (measured 64.6).

expectations.text: review.md states that with content-box sizing .docs-main occupies 1024px in total (960px plus two 32px paddings)
expectations.evidence: 'With box-sizing: content-box the box is 960 + 2 x 32 = 1024px wide'.

expectations.text: review.md flags widows: 1 and orphans: 1 as allowing single stranded lines and recommends 2 or more
expectations.evidence: Item 12: widows/orphans 1 'tells the engine a single stranded line... is fine'; fix widows: 2; orphans: 2.

expectations.text: review.md warns against letterspacing Arabic text (letter-spacing breaks joining)
expectations.evidence: Item 14: 'Letterspacing breaks the joins between letters'.

expectations.text: review.md explains that the browser's default padding-inline-start (40px) stays on the right in RTL when ul uses padding-left, so the list is indented on both sides
expectations.evidence: Item 5: 'Browsers indent lists with a default padding-inline-start: 40px... Measured in RTL: padding-left: 24px plus padding-right: 40px'.

expectations.text: review.md proposes no invalid CSS and no transform that would double-mirror a Bidi_Mirrored glyph
expectations.evidence: Every property/value and selector in the review's CSS blocks and inline fixes passed Chromium CSS.supports / insertRule (only prose ellipses and the @font-face descriptor font-display were flagged). Arrow is swapped to non-mirrored U+2190 (not scaleX); it explicitly says not to mirror > or a Bidi_Mirrored separator, scaleX only for SVG chevrons.
